Select element with options produces readable output

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<form><label>Color:</label><select><option value="red">Red</option><option value="blue" selected>Blue</option><option value="green">Green</option></select></form>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(preprocessing: { 'remove_forms' => false }))
puts result.content.inspect
```
